explanations.4: This field controls whether an AI model should be invoked to check code against this skill—usually false for static language rules.
explanations.25: The `pipefail` option changes how pipes behave; without it, a failed command in the middle of a chain won't stop the script, which is often surprising.
explanations.79: Braces like `${var}` don't actually prevent word-splitting unless you also add quotes around them—`"${var}"` is what protects the value.
explanations.146: The single quotes around `EOF` prevent Bash from expanding variables like `${job_name}` when the heredoc is created, so they stay as literal text in the generated script.
